Our mission is to build a supportive and inclusive community where students, researchers, and professionals can grow their geospatial skills together. 🌱

Want to join our Geospatial Share workshops?

We run monthly skill sharing tutorial sessions where a member of our community teaches us something they have learned along the way.

Upcoming Workshop

Working with downscaled climate projections in R

Who: Dr Ralph Trancoso, Dr Sarah Chapman, Dr Rohan Eccles (DETSI)

When: Wed May 21, 10a - 12p AEST

Where: Teams (join our mailing list for the link)

Description:

In this workshop, we will cover the use of downscaled climate projections in R. This will include working with NetCDF files, plotting, and subsetting data to a target area. This session will also cover basic calculations, such as deriving bioclimatic indices and other relevant inputs which can be used for things like species distribution modelling.

Find out more and join the workshop here.
